[LEXP.16.1] Series aggregation calls are first-class
expression atoms. The first argument to any series
aggregation is a *series cursor* — a compile-time designator
of the form `binding`, `binding.label`, `binding.slot`, or
`binding.slot.label` per [LSER.6.10].
The cursor carries the time model, accuracy, and identity key
from the matching series declaration. The full aggregation
vocabulary and per-type applicability are normative at
[LSER.16].
